changelog:
Neon Nodes v1.0.0 — Initial release

- Launches Neon Nodes, an Agentic Proof of Work NFT on Robinhood Chain.
- Supports minting by solving a single-tier arithmetic puzzle; each mint becomes a node connected by shared traits and geography.
- Step-by-step, gas-efficient mint flow: solve puzzle → sign locally → mint.
- Fully local EVM private key handling—never shared; all API calls are HTTP-only.
- Allows batch minting (up to 5 NFTs) after first single mint; clear user messages and safeguards for wallet/mint cap.
- Provides complete instructions and security best practices for all users.
summary: Neon Nodes — An Agentic Proof of Work NFT on Robinhood Chain. AI solves a single-tier arithmetic puzzle to mint. Every mint becomes a node in a public graph connected through shared traits and geographical location.
